data.name: Anas
data.gender_notes: Anas is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root أ-ن-س (ʾ-n-s), 'to be sociable, friendly'. Anas means 'friendliness'. Its root is أ-ن-س (ʾ-n-s). Borne by Anas ibn Mālik, a companion of the Prophet ﷺ. Anas is a Arabic name meaning “Friendliness; sociability; affection”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Anas expresses “Friendliness; sociability; affection”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root أ-ن-س (ʾ-n-s), 'to be sociable, friendly'. Anas means 'friendliness'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anas total 8, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
